Third party libraries used by Jobhunt (files are included, no internet needed):
- Alpine.js 3.14.3 (alpine.min.js): small reactive helpers in the HTML (menu, apply form)
- Axios 1.7.7 (axios.min.js): sends the save job and apply requests
- Chart.js 4.4.4 (chart.umd.js): charts on the admin and employer dashboards
